name: trades-runtime
title: Trades Runtime
author: Aziel Eliab
not: Not a live Worker backend in v0.

authority.note: v0 is a static documentation and ops catalog. Planned ops are named, not executed.

planned_ops.name: Dispatch
planned_ops.summary: Assign a job to a crew or technician with trade, SLA window, and site notes.

planned_ops.name: Estimate
planned_ops.summary: Capture scope, materials, labor, permits, and a written price before work starts.

planned_ops.name: Work order
planned_ops.summary: The living job record: findings, parts, photos, customer authorization.

planned_ops.name: Inspection
planned_ops.summary: Pre-work and post-work checks, code notes, and photo evidence.

planned_ops.name: Closeout
planned_ops.summary: Complete the job: sign-off, invoices, warranty, and follow-up tasks.

modules.name: HVAC
modules.author: Aziel Eliab
modules.one_line: Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning field work for service, install, and maintenance.

notes: Electrical lockout on condensing units and air handlers.
Combustion, CO, and flue integrity on gas equipment.

items: Confirm call type, equipment age, and refrigerant.
Record static pressure, temps, and customer authorization.

modules.name: Plumbing
modules.author: Aziel Eliab
modules.one_line: Supply, drain, fixture, and water-heater work inside the building envelope.

notes: Water shutoff and isolation before opening a line.
Scald and gas-connection checks on water heaters.
Wet-area electrical awareness around pumps and heaters.

items: Locate shutoffs and confirm water source.
Protect finished surfaces before opening walls or ceilings.
Pressure-test or visual-confirm the repair before closeout.

modules.name: Electrical
modules.author: Aziel Eliab
modules.one_line: Service, branch-circuit, and equipment-power work for homes and light commercial sites.
job_types: Service upgrade (planned scope only in v0)

notes: Verify de-energized with a known-live tester.
Arc-flash and PPE notes by task class.

items: Identify panel, circuit, and load before opening anything.
Photograph existing labeling and device condition.
Restore labeling and test the repaired circuit.

modules.name: Sewer
modules.author: Aziel Eliab
modules.one_line: Building drain, sewer lateral, and main-line work beyond ordinary fixture clogs.

notes: Confined-space awareness at pits and vaults.
Traffic and excavation controls when the lateral is opened.

items: Confirm cleanout access and backup location.
Capture camera footage with distance marks.
Advise on repair vs. clear, then collect authorization.

modules.name: Cross-trades
modules.author: Aziel Eliab
modules.one_line: Jobs that require more than one of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or sewer on the same ticket.
job_types: HVAC change-out that needs new electrical
Water heater swap with vent, gas, or circuit work
Equipment pad, disconnect, and condensate together

notes: Sequence trades so one crew does not energize or pressurize another crew's work.
Single accountable lead on site when scopes overlap.

items: List every trade required before the first dispatch.
Hold one estimate that names each trade's scope and exclusions.
Close the ticket only when every trade has signed its portion.
